Overall it has left a very bad taste and shows total lack of trust .. even on a returning customer...
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
"We believe every story has two sides, and we appreciate that our audience is smart enough to see that."

Every Story Has Two Sides.
Almost a year ago, a former client approached us again for his new home interiors — a client whose space we had beautifully designed four years ago. We shared a detailed proposal, finalized design fees, and began working based on mutual timelines. Over the year, we provided complete design services: concept planning, site visits, working drawings, 3Ds, and even oversaw electrical planning with the builder — all within the agreed ₹3.5lakhs.

When it was finally time to begin execution, we re-shared the final BOQ and payment schedule aligned with the project scope. Unfortunately, there were last-minute expectations for heavy discounts and unreasonable payment terms that left no room for fair professional working. We tried our best to find middle ground, but when it didn’t work, we respectfully opted to discontinue the execution and stick only to design consultation.

That too wasn’t acceptable, and rather than closing the conversation amicably, the client chose to leave without notice — and soon after, posted a defamatory comment.

Yes, we are rigid — with our processes, with timelines, with fairness in payments. Because structure and standardization is how we bring professionalism to a largely unorganized industry. We don’t compromise on ethics, quality, or self-respect.

If we are not aligned, it’s okay not to work together — but publicly disrespecting a small business trying to do the right thing is not.

We trust people will see through and value businesses that work with transparency and integrity.
